fx._note: Conservative (ECB 2026-10-06 = 1.1269 USD/EUR, staging fx_reference_rates). Lower = higher USD costs in EUR.

openai_cost_per_action_usd._basis: ESTIMATE from token counts derived from prompt/schema sizes in repo (chars/3.2) + image tokens (internal 2026-09-26 estimate, not re-measured). No live calls made. No usage telemetry exists (response.usage not logged).

intent_fallback_call._note: low = prompt cache hit; typical = no cache; high = +1 retry share

openai_cost_per_action_usd._terminology: Esblu nemá samostatný AI chatbot/asistent. „Text command“ = písaný príkaz do existujúceho Intent Engine (deterministický parser zadarmo, OpenAI iba intent classification fallback). Hlas = gpt-4o-transcribe + ten istý Intent Engine.
